comment: Lua library values, like `math.pi`, `io.stdout`, `package.path` or `_G`. The builtin Lua grammar gives them the same `constant.language.lua` scope as `true`, `false` and `nil`, so they would be highlighted as constants. They are regular table fields and globals, same as `Math.PI` in JavaScript, so this rule scopes them as `support.variable.library.lua`. Same names as in the builtin grammar.
